answer: Simultaneous exam slots: at a random minute each epoch every identity must solve a fresh puzzle within 60 seconds on a distinct machine. 10 fakes need 10 servers at $5 a month each, 100 need $500, so cost grows linearly while an honest user pays $5 once. The seed waits in a vault until the minute opens and travels by private whisper message, so nobody can solve it early. No single ocean region may host over 20 percent of slots. Peers re-check 10 percent of answers and slash a $20 bond on failure. Limit: rented cloud fleets pay only the linear cost.
